The following events occurred in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''4,606 before the Battle of Yavin'''.

==Events==
*The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kel'eth Ur]] is [[Death/Legends|killed]] for his heretical [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] teachings by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], and his body is entombed in the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Buried Power" /><ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref>

==Deaths==
